wizard.deliverable: Expected delivery: source ZIP, setup instructions, and a static review report. Manual runtime evaluation remains necessary.
wizard.title: Build a complete project
wizard.subtitle: Describe your local app, approve its proposal and download the generated source.
wizard.baseline: React + Vite · Browser-only or local fullstack CRUD · English / Spanish · Light / dark
wizard.stepHelp.idea: Start with the outcome you need. Your description and constraints stay attached to this project as its requirements.
wizard.stepHelp.proposal: Review the scope, data and local architecture before approving. Approval is tied to this exact proposal revision.
wizard.stepHelp.generate: Authorize one bounded generation run. Follow each live milestone below; source is reviewed statically and never run here.
wizard.stepHelp.download: Your named source archive is ready. Download it, then follow its README to evaluate it in your own environment.
wizard.progressNote: Milestones show pipeline position, not elapsed time. Keep this page open to follow live updates.
wizard.stageHelp.prepared: The approved scope is ready. Generation starts only after you authorize it below.
wizard.stageHelp.workers: Independent workstreams are creating the interface and domain validation. Completed deliveries are preserved.
wizard.stageHelp.integration: Verified workstreams are being connected to the selected application template.
wizard.stageHelp.review: The assembled source and interface are being checked. No generated code is executed.
wizard.stageHelp.packaging: The reviewed source and its report are being assembled into the final project folder.
wizard.stageHelp.completed: All approved milestones are complete. Your source archive is ready below.
wizard.deleteWarning: This removes the project, plan, approvals and history from the app. Original JSON and generated files remain on disk; they are not deleted automatically. You cannot undo this from this screen.
project.deleteMismatch: The name or revision changed. Reload the project before deleting it.
wizard.scope: Local forms, lists, filters and persistence. No accounts, payments, external services or deployment.
wizard.plannerConsent: I authorize sending this description and any previous plan to Codex to prepare a proposal, using my account limits.
wizard.planning: Preparing your proposal; implementation has not started.
wizard.legacy: This project needs a compatible new proposal and approval. Historical deliveries will not be overwritten or reused automatically.
wizard.approved: Proposal approved. Continue to generation authorization.
wizard.planEdit: Saving edits creates a revision and invalidates approval. Preserve the technical contract format.
wizard.authorization: One authorization for the approved scope
wizard.consent: I confirm this folder and authorize independent Codex agents to generate, integrate and review the project with up to two correction cycles and account usage. No installation, execution, builds, tests or deployment.
wizard.prepared: Ready to generate. No implementation agent has started.
wizard.workers: Generating interface and domain logic with independent agents. Valid deliveries are retained if another agent fails.
wizard.integration: Connecting verified deliveries to the selected template.
wizard.review: Checking source and contracts, followed by independent AI review. Generated code is not being executed.
wizard.packaging: Preparing the project and review report for download.
wizard.completed: Your project is ready to download
wizard.unverified: Statically reviewed; not executed or tested.
wizard.warning: This source has not been run or tested. Follow the generated README to install dependencies and evaluate it manually; static review does not prove functionality or security.
wizard.resumeNote: Retained files are verified first. Resuming uses the original authorization and remaining attempts, without resetting the correction limit.
wizard.reassessNote: The saved frontend, domain, and integration files can be rechecked without regenerating them or adding correction cycles. A retained review is checked again against current deterministic safeguards; no new Codex call is made when it is reusable. A genuine blocker still prevents download.
wizard.reassessConsent: I authorize reuse of the prior independent report or, if none is recoverable, one Codex review that may use my account. No installation, execution, build or runtime tests.
wizard.noDeliveries: No validated delivery saved yet. The planned folder is not an existing application.
wizard.failed: No final application or ZIP was created. Retained source deliveries are not an approved final artifact.
wizard.blocked: Generation is blocked. Review the technical reason before recovery.
wizard.interrupted: The server restarted. Nothing resumed automatically.
wizard.cancelled: Generation stopped. Completed deliveries remain available.
wizard.cancelling: Stopping processes and waiting for their exit.
wizard.connection: Status cannot be refreshed. Activity is unknown; actions are disabled until reconnection.
wizard.summary: Agent summary in its original language
gen.contractInvalid: Invalid technical contract. Correct or regenerate the proposal.
gen.contractRequired: A new fullstack v2 proposal and approval are required.
gen.unsupported: The proposal exceeds local CRUD scope. Adjust the requirements.
gen.stale: The plan, contract or template changed. The previous approval cannot authorize recovery.
gen.busy: Another operation is active. Wait until it finishes.
gen.consentRequired: Confirm revision, managed folder, static review and two-correction limit.
gen.cannotReassess: This generation is not eligible for a one-time recheck or authorization is missing.
gen.noRetainedDelivery: A complete saved frontend, backend and integration are required for rechecking.
gen.noRetainedReview: Reviewer attempts are exhausted and no prior report can be recovered.
gen.reviewerAttemptsExhausted: The reviewer did not return a valid report after three attempts. No source correction cycles were consumed.
gen.useExisting: This revision already has a generation. Its attempt budget cannot be reset.
gen.cannotResume: This generation cannot resume in its current state.
gen.notActive: This generation is no longer active.
gen.deliveryInvalid: The agent did not return the exact files required by the contract.
gen.catalogInvalid: Catalogs must be separate JSON files with nonempty string values.
gen.workerFailed: The agent process failed. Private diagnostics are retained locally.
gen.reviewInvalid: The reviewer returned an invalid report.
gen.attemptLimit: This role exhausted its three process attempts, including interruptions.
gen.correctionsExhausted: The two correction cycles are exhausted; no complete download is available.
gen.artifactChanged: A retained file is missing, modified or unsafe. Recovery and download are blocked.
gen.outputLimit: Generated output exceeds the safe size limit.
gen.unsafePath: An unsafe output path was rejected.
gen.processEvidence: Real process completion evidence is missing.
gen.templateBlocked: Review found a server-owned template problem. Agents cannot modify it.
gen.destinationExists: The final folder exists and will not be overwritten.
gen.notReady: No complete statically reviewed project is available.
gen.internal: Internal generation error. Retained deliveries were not deleted.
gen.requestFailed: Request failed. Check the local server.
gen.templateMismatch: The brief requires browser-only storage or no application server, but this plan selects Express/SQLite. Prepare and approve a new browser-only proposal.
wizard.manualBrowser: For manual evaluation, extract the ZIP, inspect package.json and README.md, then run npm install and npm run dev yourself. This development server is tooling, not an application backend.
wizard.manualFullstack: For manual evaluation, extract the ZIP, inspect package.json and README.md, then run npm install and npm run dev yourself. The local Express server stores records in SQLite.
